features: [Round Dining Table Set] Unique Design Round table top with no sharp corners, which helps to protect your children and the elderly. The legs of the table are composed of four bent columns and two base rails. There is a small shelf in the middle of the table, measuring 12.4*12.4 inches. The unique design not only adds a beautiful table to your living room, but also saves space and creates an ideal living room for you.

[Upholstered Chairs] The seat cushion is made of high-quality high-density foam material, with higher comfort and a thickness of 60 mm, which provides you with a soft ride experience and allows you to enjoy delicious food in a relaxed state. Exquisite retro hollow chair back provides you with reliable support, and unique table foot design helps to protect your floor.

[High Quantity Material] The tabletop is made of high-quality MDF, which is smooth and durable. The legs of the table and chairs are made of LVL, which are strong enough to support you and your family. Weight capacity of table: 300 pounds, Weight capacity of chair: 250 pounds.
[Dimension] Table: 42"L x 42"W x 30"H, 51.48 LBS; Chair: 16.1"L x 17.9"W x 37.7"H, 58.96 LBS; Seat Dimensions: 17.3"L x 15.3"W.

[Assembly and Customer Service] Complete assembly is required. This dining table set comes with detailed instructions that can be followed step by step to help you complete the assembly as quickly as possible. Any damage during transit or any defects after receipt will be covered. If you have any questions, please feel free to contact our customer service.
